author: United States Department of State
title: The Peace Treaty of Brest-Litovsk, 3 March 1918 (Papers Relating to the Foreign Relations of the United States, 1918, Russia)
publisher: The Avalon Project, Lillian Goldman Law Library, Yale Law School
notes: The English text of the treaty as printed in the United States diplomatic papers and reproduced by the Avalon Project, read in full. It is a translation made for a foreign ministry, not a scholarly edition of the German or Russian originals, and its article numbering is the one this pack quotes. The map that Article III makes 'an essential part of this treaty of peace' is not reproduced there, which is why this pack draws no line for the frontier the treaty created.
